sql:
select 'paper_mmsell10' k, count(*) n, max(created_at)::text latest from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
union all select 'live_Fmmsell10', count(*), max(created_at)::text from live_orders where strategy='Fmmsell10' and created_at > now() - interval '60 minutes'
union all select 'live_Hmmsell10', count(*), max(created_at)::text from live_orders where strategy='Hmmsell10'
union all select 'paper_Hmmsell10', count(*), max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where strategy in ('Hmmsell10','Hmmsell10_pt4')
